name: Appointment Date Validation — Invalid Date Rejected by Workflow
goal: User provides a date that fails external appointment date validator; bot displays exact reason and re-prompts.
constraints: Appointment date is a Sunday, which is not allowed per validator workflow.

result.message: You are eligible to book an appointment.

result.reason: Appointments cannot be booked on Sundays.

phases.description: Bot presents booking option; user chooses to book.
Bot asks for coverage type; user selects 'Only Spouse'.
Bot collects spouse details; user provides valid name and DOB.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot accepts spouse name and DOB.

phases.description: User provides a date that is a Sunday.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot calls validator, receives isValid=false, displays exact reason, and re-prompts.

phases.description: User provides a valid date; bot validates successfully.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
